status: pre-registered before any integration result was computed (no blend / change-time / RWY 18 numbers of this round seen)
data_layer: fra.dataset KNOWN_LAG_H = 2 (od_now = label of [t-2h, t-1h)), ICON-EU fill, 48 training leads; production logit = experiments.harness.production_preds (fra.train exactly)

test.long: issue 2026-06-01 .. holdout start, valid < 2026-11-01 (fra.evalkit TEST_START, weekly walk-forward folds)
test.holdout: issue >= 2026-11-01 never used for any choice below

main_configuration_fixed_in_advance.decision_model: fra.decision.DEFAULT (logit C 0.1, 10 m wind, look-ahead h+1..h+6), refit weekly on transition rows with h + 6 h <= week start; RWY 18 closure model on rows with h + 2 h <= week start
main_configuration_fixed_in_advance.wind_paths: fra.fcerror.DEFAULT, 200 paths per issue, seed 0, strict walk-forward library
main_configuration_fixed_in_advance.rollout: starts at label hour t-1 from od_now = label of hour t-2 (the production od_now); wind hours <= t observed (METAR, no gap interpolation), later hours = Part B paths; look-ahead features from the ensemble-mean path (anticipate='mean')

1_od_blend.primary_metric: paired Brier over all leads 1..48 and Brier(1,6,24,48) vs the production logit, day-block bootstrap 95 % CI (fra.evalkit, 2000 reps), same (issue, lead) rows
1_od_blend.reported: accuracy and Brier at 1/6/24/48 h with paired CIs vs logit, long test and selection-free part; decision rollout alone; legacy-lag rollout (start t from label t-1) as a reference for what the honest od_now costs

candidates: per lead bucket (1-3, 4-12, 13-30, 31-48 h) weight on the logit, grid 0..1 step 0.05, each test week fitted (min Brier) on the out-of-sample rows of earlier test weeks with valid + 2 h <= week start; 0.5 until 2 earlier weeks exist
2_blend_weights.rule: adopt per-bucket weights only if the paired Brier(all leads) difference vs fixed 0.5 has a 95 % CI upper bound < 0 on the long test AND a negative point estimate on the selection-free part; otherwise keep 0.5

candidates: DEFAULT with simulated gust mapped to the METAR convention (gust kept only if >= mean + 10 kt)
3_part_b_variants.rule: replace DEFAULT only if the blend with the variant beats the blend with DEFAULT on paired Brier(all leads) with 95 % CI upper bound < 0 on the long test and a negative point estimate on the selection-free part

4_change_time.issues: issue times whose whole 48 h horizon is labelled and ends before the holdout (fra.changetime.walk_forward_paths rule), od_now = production od_now; actual change = fra.changetime.actual_first_change (>= 2 h), hit = +-3 h

candidates.i_hysteresis_on_blend: fra.changetime rule (smooth, enter, leave, k over fra.changetime.GRID) applied to the blended P(other OD), nested walk-forward (week w scored with parameters best on weeks < w); P(change within 48 h) = walk-forward logistic on logit(max smoothed P(other OD)); window = enter +- WINDOW_BAND crossings
candidates.ii_decision_paths: from the rollout: P(changed by lead L) = 1 - P(no switch through lead L) (switches in the unpublished hours t-1, t count for lead 1); predicted change = first lead with P(changed) >= thr, thr in {0.30, 0.35, ..., 0.70} nested walk-forward; P(change within 48 h) = 1 - P(no switch through lead 48), walk-forward logistic recalibration (raw also reported); window = quartiles of the conditional first-change distribution
candidates.references: current PARAMS on the logit (production today), nested rule on the logit, published prognosis, official rules, persistence

4_change_time.rule: change time from the candidate with the higher out-of-sample event accuracy (weeks >= 1); if the paired difference CI includes 0 and |diff| < 1 pp, prefer the one with fewer false alarms; P(change within 48 h) from the candidate with the lower walk-forward Brier; the window comes with the chosen change time

5_rwy18.period: weekly walk-forward from 2025-09-01 (fold weeks counted from 2025-09-01), valid < 2026-11-01; rows where every candidate has a prediction

candidates.R2: decision-study RWY 18 closure model (P(closed | steady tailwind on 18, OD)) on Part B wind paths, combined with the logit P(OD 25): P(open) = 1 - [P25 * mean_paths c25 + (1 - P25) * mean_paths c07]

5_rwy18.metrics: Brier (pooled all leads, and 1/6/24/48), Brier skill vs walk-forward climatology (training closure rate), AUC of P(closed), hit rate of closure hours at P(open) < 0.8, false alarms (open hours flagged) per 1,000 h
5_rwy18.rule: replace R1 only if the candidate's paired pooled Brier difference vs R1 has a 95 % CI upper bound < 0 and its false alarms per 1,000 h are at most 2x R1's; among several, the lowest Brier

noise_note: about 38 variants were compared on the same June-October test in the previous round; gains of ~0.001-0.002 Brier are within selection noise; the locked holdout from 2026-11-01 is the referee
